title.narrative: Technical Assistance - Liquified Natural Gas Supply and Natural Gas Infrastructure Technical Exchange Program, through National US Arab Chamber Of Commerce (Inc)

description.narrative: This contract funds a technical exchange program to introduce Bangladeshi delegates from the government and parastatal sectors to U.S. technology, regulations and best practices for value-based natural gas infrastructure planning and technical capacity building, as well as U.S. technologies in liquefied natural gas and gas-related equipment and services. The delegates will travel to two cities in the United States in order to meet with U.S. companies and conduct site visits to see American technology manufactured and in use.
